subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers require live current-main Slack Socket Mode reaction-envelope proof before promoting any fix PR for this issue?
rationale: Source inspection shows plausible handler and filter boundaries, but the issue's central zero-envelope symptom cannot be safely attributed to one code path without live Slack diagnostics.

options.title: Require live reaction-envelope proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted raw Socket Mode envelopes, gateway trace logs, and account identity data before changing code.

options.title: Fold into broader Socket Mode diagnosis
options.body: Use the broader Slack Socket Mode delivery issue as the diagnostic umbrella only if it gains public evidence that covers reactions specifically.

options.title: Sponsor a maintainer live repro
options.body: A maintainer with Slack workspace access can reproduce the multi-account reaction flow on current main and decide the fix boundary from observed logs.

recommendation.title: Require live reaction-envelope proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for redacted raw Socket Mode envelopes, gateway trace logs, and account identity data before changing code.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current and historical signal across Slack monitor, reaction, and account-filter paths.
